t: The DEWALT Extreme Hex Shank Triple-Flute Auger Wood Drill Bit Set provides efficient wood drilling for trade professionals and serious DIYers. Featuring impact-rated ¼" hex shanks, these hardened steel auger bits are compatible with both impact drivers and standard jawed chuck drills. Its triple-flute design and three cutting spurs ensure cleaner, faster holes and extended drilling life, making it ideal for timber framing and general construction. A full-screw self-feeding tip allows for effortless pull-through, drilling holes up to 100mm deep in soft and hard wood. This versatile set includes common sizes from 13 to 32mm.
b: Can be Used with Rotary & Impact Modes
Tri-Flute Design for Clean & Fast Holes
Quick-Change Hex Shanks for Easy Swaps
3 x Cutting Spurs Extend Drilling Life
